theorems.statement: ∀ (P m r : ℕ) (N W : Set (Euclid P)) (V : Set (Euclid m)) (ψ : Euclid m → Euclid P) (Q : Euclid P → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (Φ : Euclid P → Euclid P), 1 ≤ r → IsOpen V → IsOpen W → ContDiffOn ℝ r ψ V → InjOn ψ V → ψ '' V = W ∩ N → (∀ K ⊆ W, IsCompact K → IsCompact (V ∩ ψ ⁻¹' K)) → (∀ z ∈ V, Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ z)) → (∀ x ∈ N, (Q x : Set (Euclid P)) = tangentSpace N x) → ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ → Injective Φ → (∀ x, Injective (fderiv ℝ Φ x)) → ∀ B : Set (Euclid P), B ⊆ W ∩ N → MeasurableSet B → ∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, ∫⁻ y in Φ '' B, g y ∂μHE[m] = ∫⁻ x in B, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ (Q x)) => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ x (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ (Q x) i)) (fderiv ℝ Φ x (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ (Q x) j))))) * g (Φ x) ∂μHE[m]
